def.state: board trend-state rule on the SMA (eval_lib outcomes, agg any, hysteresis 2/0.5)

readings.state20: sign(up − dn) of the SMA20 state over the segment
readings.fresh20: SMA20 state balance over the window counting only states that begin inside it
readings.state8: sign(up − dn) of the SMA8 state over the segment
readings.fresh8: SMA8 state balance over the window counting only states that begin inside it
readings.price: sign(last close − first open) over the segment

def.outcome: follow = same sign; reverse = opposite; none = close direction 0

refs.day: cash session up to the close window
refs.day90: cash session up to the 90-minute window (15-minute window only)
refs.pre: the 75 minutes before the final window (15-minute window only)
refs.full: from 08:00 UK to the close window (US rows only)
refs.bias200: side of the 200SMA at the last close before the window
